scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && tsc && EXTENSION_VERSION="${EXTENSION_VERSION:-0.0.0}" HUTCH_SERVER_URL=https://readplace.com node scripts/build-extension.js
scripts.compile-dev: rm -rf dist && tsc && HUTCH_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 node scripts/build-extension.js
scripts.lint: tsc --project tsconfig.lint.json && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "biome lint src" "knip" "editorconfig-checker" "pnpm check-unused-css"
scripts.test:e2e: E2E_PORT=3000 HUTCH_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 node scripts/build-extension.js && E2E_PORT=3000 node --test dist/e2e/login-flow/run.e2e-local.main.js
scripts.check-infra: PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE='' pulumi preview --stack "${PULUMI_STACK:?PULUMI_STACK is not set}"
scripts.ext:run: EXTENSION_VERSION="${EXTENSION_VERSION:-0.0.0}" HUTCH_SERVER_URL=https://readplace.com node scripts/build-extension.js && web-ext run --source-dir dist-extension-compiled
